notes.title: Summer Is Here Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/fd5de72f090e50291e33c6032e2878fbfbb02d58.png[/img]

Get ready for the largest update so far, and probably the last one before the full release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/d61c5026199872fe67fc5bfa53d6f9d71a28a456.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/3e07f523a17902ce06b0c47100a308096d9d6804.png[/img]

Summer Update: Welcome to the Komakas Region!

This summer, embark on a new adventure with a dozen new levels in the Komakas region. The Komakas is the stretch of sea separating the Edge from the rest of the continent. Continue your journey from the battle against Greedy Bear and explore the islands until you reach the Continent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/99d31cae0fef8e828d26f33bac155a2dd6931d4a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/1e7cff2de9d5561f5525cbf1c29c73b1c4ad39cf.png[/img]

To reach the Komakas, you can also take advantage of the tunnels under the Edge, offering a convenient shortcut if you can find them. These tunnels can be accessed from the Serene Tunnels, bypassing the surrounding caves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/c6456d5c0df5a9b78f3ae8fac34754d69d348c90.png[/img]

While exploring the islands, encounter new foes including sparring pirates, bomb-tossing pirates, and mysterious giant tentacles. Use boats and balloons to travel to distant locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/ae07dd6f7c0f6805210b88f300eb14c29fe555e9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/23a5525e4434c683d08ee90d358e2da7d33254f7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/5d969df8095b0bfad4258f3e60ae5039455ae526.gif[/img]
The Komakas region introduces a new power on the Power Table: the Magic Carpet. This power allows you to levitate for a short time, helping you traverse further than you could on foot.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/bf907bffe8f459b31fc65e5d000fc2fd8210c0f9.png[/img]

The Infinite Tower has been revamped with new challenges and increased difficulty as you delve deeper. This one-player challenge ends after 10 hits or deaths, providing a true test of your skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/ca8516abbb6dc229fc49b948a1e549e900d10c59.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/b71a2b82a04676e0430a40c9fc7630b080d3231d.png[/img]

Alongside new content, existing levels in the Edge Caves have been adjusted for easier completion. Additionally, this update comes numerous bug fixes and other improvements to enhance your overall experience.

Prepare for an epic adventure in Wawa United's biggest update yet!



Oh yeah and by the way we're on sale for the Steam Summer Sale, so there's that!

notes.title: Quick patch, preparing major update
notes.content:
A quick patch has been published in order to address connectivity issues. 
The game should now connect normally. The game intro splash has been modified and is now using the stock Unity splash. 
On a side note, the game should load faster than before, and keep a constant resolution. 

New levels are now available, and will be properly introduced in a separate post.

notes.title: Wawa United is back online
notes.content: The game is back online via the new released client. There's no extra content beside the hosting changes. But more will come soon indeed!

notes.title: The game is temporarily unavailable
notes.content:
Due to a change in hosting, Wawa United will be temporarily unavailable for a few hours. The game will be updated to reflect the change, and everything will be back to normal very soon.
All previous versions of the game will not work anymore.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.7
notes.content:
[h2]Patch 0.9.7[/h2]

A new patch has been issued.
Both full and test versions have been updated.

[h3]New things:[/h3]
Auto Chat
Introducing for absolutely no reason the Auto Chat option, leveraging the power of ChatGPT. 
When you enable the GPT option in the chat box, you will be able to answer automatically to your friends or even bots!
[i]This feature depends on the availability of ChatGPT, downtimes may occur.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/d16f7d157cc569994cbc1911481a65b0b149fe74.png[/img]

[h3]UI Improvements:[/h3]
- Directional arrows have been significantly improved. Including the helper arrows you can place using F. You can now press F once to show a location, and press again to remove the location.
- The status of players will now be displayed, allowing other players to know if their friends are AFK, or writing something. 
- End level screen has been improved and will be more accurate.

[h3]Gameplay changes:[/h3]
- Enemies will now drop more rewards, including health boosts if your health is low. This is to compensate health boosts being exceedingly rare previously.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
- Networking has been improved, hopefully to reduce stutter. 
- Tons of minor bug fixes.

[h2]Upcoming updates :[/h2]
Apart from this, work on new levels is still underway, with heavy testing and fine tuning going on, and should be out in not too long !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/cd544cdedbdbbb9dedb82f92f4292ca7feacec6a.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 0.9.5_d
notes.content:
Wawa United has been updated. Both demo and full versions have been updated, with changes as follow:
- Various networking, UI and display bugs have been fixed.
- Jumps are now easier.

notes.title: Content update: 0.9.5 Infinite Tower
notes.content:
Wawa United version 0.9.5 is now live:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/bcf76aaf364061ebee7a614578a14666648e82f8.png[/img]
The Infinite Tower is now available ! A single player, randomly generated level where the goal is to last as long as you can. Open to all players of the full version of Wawa United!

The level is available right after "The Hidden Bay of Wonders". It does not unlock any other level. If you already completed the Bay, it will be unlocked automatically for you.
If completed by any one player, the Tower will regenerate itself!

You may also witness the following changes:

- The game will now start MUCH faster thanks to various optimizations.
- You can now carve your own messages at the end of a level (instead of having a limited choice of pre-written sentences).
- Sound effects have been modified.
- A new enemy has been added. In addition to the pink and blue Furballs, a yellow Furball is now roaming around. Advice, don't shoot bombs at it in a confined space!
- UI has been revamped further to look more attractive.
- New animations have been added, including upon grabbing items or setting levers.
- Bombs now have a visual representation on the characters.
- The flashlight power will can now lighten up an environment when you press Shoot
- A purple gem has been introduced. The purple gem is worth 10 points and only drops in enemies and suspended bags.
- The netcode has been improved to work much better under high ping conditions. High pings are still not ideal. 
- Characters will no longer flip the wrong way after crouching.
- Tons of other bugs have been fixed.
- The "The Hidden Bay of Wonders" has hopefully be made clearer to understand.

notes.title: Update 0.9.4
notes.content:
Wawa United has been updated to version 0.9.4.

[u][b]URGENT[/b][/u]: Drastic performance issues, failures to connect and random disconnections have been reported in multiplayer games, making online multiplayer next to unplayable. These issues have been analyzed, their causes are known, and they are being worked on. [b]This is the highest priority at the moment[/b] and a hotfix should be published soon. I am absolutely sorry for the inconvenience. It is advised to avoid multiplayer until they are resolved.

[u][b]IMPORTANT[/b][/u]: If the game causes issues on start or if the controls do not respond as they should, you should reset the keybinds to their defaults in the settings menu. If this does not work, REMOVE the folder User/YourUserName/AppData/Roaming/WawaUnited. No worries, it is designed to regenerate.

Here are the changes :
- UI has been modified to be more friendly to controllers. You can navigate the UI using arrow keys. This is still a work in progress, but most critical interfaces are working.
- Some levels have been modified and simplified. They also have been optimized to work better on lower end machines.
- A huge number of bugs have been resolved.

- A bug disconnecting players in the Cave Escape level has been solved.

notes.title: Update 0.9.2

Changes:

Graphics :

Merry Christmas !

Wawa United Dev

notes.title: Next (Content) Update Incoming & Details
notes.content:
Hello back dear frogs,

It's been a long while without news. As the latest build was looking stable enough, I didn't rush into pushing bug fixing patches every other week and started focusing on new content. I originally was eager to push the first huge content update for Wawa United on its first release anniversary, September 11th. 
Obviously, I missed the deadline*, but there is good news: there is  a lot of content and bug fixes on the pipes. I have been putting every single hour of the time I had available into creating this new content and hopefully it will be worth it once it's ready. 
I am eager to share it with you, so I will use this post to detail what is going on, and also some screenshots!

* [i]I would have missed it anyway.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/31901383bb3a564ff1d12fa25c58d8ecc77d1c9f.png[/img]
[h2]1. Komaka Islands are coming[/h2]
After the caves, part 2 of the adventures are about to be released. You will at last venture out of the Edge, to the Komaka archipelago. Introducing new enemies, new situations, a new power into brand new adventures. Your goal this time? Reach the mainland!
Also, a new market is available with new hardware to further customize your home!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/8795a7e7245fd42c4f074fc04d8ddec97ae92b9e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/75c84062acf0e5b9f81113844f28063edbdd802a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/1d69e550851a0a9b32fd5b58166a7ad81b361d8f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/af1d8798463676049fc9a02dd7b422b791cf8ecd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/75c84062acf0e5b9f81113844f28063edbdd802a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/efeb223853dffc43cba723537f1be8df9612af1b.png[/img]

[h2]The Infinite Tower[/h2]
The Infinite Tower has been on the map long enough and it will soon open its doors to eager adventurers. It is a dungeon to be explored alone, with a sequence of increasingly difficult challenges that are constantly changing. The first frog to reach its end will be richly rewarded, which doesn't mean other contenders won't. Whenever the end is reached by anyone, the whole dungeon resets with a brand new challenge. Also, you may meet new "friends" on the way.

On your way, you'll be able to spray cryptic messages on some rocks so the adventurers behind you can benefit from your experience.
Also, your life won't matter as much in this dungeon, as you will be granted a certain number of "attempts" which will decrease each time you get hurt or otherwise commit a mistake. Once you're out of attempts, that's it, you get booted out of the tower.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/8d9c80a2639953ea6b3899a6ae9c06fe53dd3b29.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/b0ef9036b2252f671327a91ac72738169d348853.png[/img]

[h2]Candy Land[/h2]
Not only the Komakas are coming, but also the land of Candies. 
There is still so much to do so this one. it might not be present in the next update. However it should follow shortly and introduce the first 4 players map in the game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/debff6a376fbbbc6dbfe0eceb2904fee9c08921e.png[/img]

[h2][b]Full controller support[/b][/h2]
It was ridiculous that the game only supported controllers as an afterthought and didn’t allow for alternative key mappings. This will now be fixed. 
Note that the game still does not support couch multiplayer : you can play solo, but only by controlling frogs one after the other.

[h2]Graphic and performance improvements[/h2]
UI has been polished. All levels, even the existing ones, have been made better looking. They also run smoother. The world map will also run significantly better on lower end machines.
An indicator will show where your teammates are, and also their chats.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
Many, many bugs have been fixed. Levels should run smoother, UI should be less awkward in some places. Hopefully your experience will be much better. 
As for the networking experience, if you play online, despite doing my best at testing everything beforehand, I can only rely on your feedback and experience to improve the lag and correct bugs. I am the sole developer on this project, so my own testing abilities are limited. 
Don’t hesitate to use the handy feedback function. 

I don't have a precise ETA but I'd say roughly a month from now. I may push the Infinite Tower before the Islands if I finish one before the other. It would be pointless to keep all the goodies away just to publish everything in one time.

Anyway, thank you for your patience and I'll be back soon enough!

Adrien

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
An update has been published for both full and demo versions. Here are the changes:

- A tracking arrow will now show your partners whenever they are off screen.
- Fixed some glitches with lightning in some places where lightning was supposed to be improved.

However, some bugs remain that will hopefully be fixed soon :

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
After a long while, an update has been published for both demo and full versions.
Note that I am still working on the next content updates, which will bring the Komaka Islands to life, allowing our favorite frogs to cross the sea separating the Edge from the Continent, and continue their travel.
I am still working on The Infinite Tower, but technical challenges and the need to focus on other things led me to push it to the second position and prioritize the Komakas instead. It is coming.

But for now here are the changes :

- Graphic improvements with lightning. Water will now have subtle caustic effects and outdoor sections will have clouds affecting the environment.
- The world map has been updated and will now include elements for the new coming sections.
- A button has been added to quick collect Gems from gem-generating items in your home.

- Some minor update and fixes.

NOTE :
Please ignore if the game keeps telling you an update is needed. It will be resolved later today.

notes.title: Minor Patch
notes.content:
I tried to be clever while trying to optimize loading times, which resulted in major instabilities or in some cases completely disabling online play. Because you know, nothing faster than not loading anything amirite! 
Well, this has been fixed and online is now back. Don't hesitate to contact me if the game keeps behaving somehow.

The patch is for both demo and full versions, here are the changes:
- Online multiplayer has been fixed. A bug introduced in a previous version would time out players trying to join a lobby. 
- The world map has been slightly improved. 
- Other minor stuff has been improved but really I didn't keep track.

notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
A minor update has been published for both demo and full versions, here are the changes:
- Minor bug fixes.
- Work under the hood for updates to come.


The update is of a bigger size than usual, this is because of major changes in the API and the compiler. Hopefully this has been tested and should be bug-free and seamless. However if any unexpected bug should pop up, don't hesitate to report it.

- Corrected minor bug where pressure plate triggered moving platforms wouldn't go to the right destination.
- Minor adjustments have been made to some levels.

Cheers, and keep exploring

notes.title: Update 0.9.1
notes.content:
Wawa United 0.9.1 has been published for both demo and full versions. The changes are as follow :

- You can now carve a custom comment and a custom picture when you finish a level under certain circumstances : when you win, when you finish an adventure for the first time, and when you perfect it (meaning, you cleaned every single gem with full health double bonus).

Many improvements have been made and bugs fixed :

- Blank green screens have been resolved for online games. They should not occur anymore when trying to join a lobby.
- Actions should now respond correctly under all circumstances.
- and many minor bug fixes.
HOWEVER, it is important to note that demo accounts cannot play online with full versions, for technical reasons not related to design. Trying to join a demo lobby for a full version or vice versa will end up in connection attempt timing out. 

Many changes have been made under the hood for this version, if you find any broken mechanic, don’t forget to use the bug report button.

Cheers
- Bugs have been fixed, notably bugs concerning the opening of Parcels and some lobby item placement bugs.
- The Infinite Tower is now shown on the world map right after you complete The Hidden Bay Of Wonders. Is is still inaccessible and cannot be unlocked. Players who have already completed The Hidden Bay Of Wonders may not see it yet, but it will be made available for everyone as soon as it is released.
- The UI won't rebel anymore when trying to set a Graffiti Stone. 
- Bug report now allows you to leave an e-mail address (optional) in case of need for follow-up.
- Switching between characters won't cause the character you switch from to keep running.

notes.title: Unscheduled Minor Update
notes.content:
A minor update has been applied to both demo and full versions. It should have been part of the next content update, but it was hard to justify retaining the bug fixes when I can just be awesome right away. 

The next content update should be coming March 1st, next monday.

Ine the meanwhile, here are the patch notes for 0.9.0b:
- Fixed bugs concerning the opening of Parcels and some lobby item placement bugs.
- The Infinite Tower is now shown on the world map right after you complete The Hidden Bay Of Wonders. Is is still inaccessible and cannot be unlocked. Players who have already completed The Hidden Bay Of Wonders may not see it yet, but it will be made available for everyone as soon as it is released.
- The UI won't disappear/stick around/show the wrong graffiti anymore when trying to set a Graffiti Stone. 
- Bug report now allows you to leave an e-mail address (optional) in case of need for follow-up. I received some bug reports I wasn't able to reproduce, therefore to fix, and I though it'd be a good idea for me to be able to reach out.
- Switching between characters won't cause the character you switch from to keep running.

There is a long standing bug causing the ACTION key to sometimes not react in solo mode, and require two presses to work. I am working on fixing it.

Cheers, and keep exploring!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/3e658735b8044459577aa98f98276a72f0ce6a52.png[/img]

notes.title: Inventory Bug Hotfixed
notes.content:
A bug in the end level loot was causing some player's inventory to bug and make their items unusable.

The bug has been fixed and loot should be now properly assigned and interpreted by the clients. No client save was corrupted so you should expect to find your inventory as it was. An extra Parcel was added to those accounts affected. 

Sorry for the inconvenience. Remember to use the bug report function if you have any problem in-game, it helps me react fast to any game-breaking bug. The bug report will let you leave an e-mail address for follow-up soon. 

A content update is coming soon and I am working on it right now.

Cheers

Adrien

notes.title: Update 0.9.0
notes.content:
Since there was a lot to do lately, and since it would make more sense to bundle all improvements into the next update, I took a break from the weekly updates schedule. 
Now is the time to introduce the first batch of new features that will be introduced gradually in the next weeks.

This is update 0.9.0 Alpha for Wawa United. Here are the patch notes :
- [b]New feature : Graffitis[/b]. You will now find some places in your adventures where you can leave an emote, or share the image you want.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/ee321f9df24f3bac93e3209756aad33a50baf1eb.png[/img]
	All players playing this adventure will be able to see your graffiti, until another player replaces it with his own. 
	Putting graffitis costs 1 Paint Bucket.
- [b]New feature : download pictures from web[/b] as emotes. You can now find a "Web" section in the Emotes interface. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/5689a7ec07ef8f01c90e3fd5aa62f86d671f6136.png[/img]
	It allows you to download a picture from one of the allowed shared pictures hosting services. 
	Just copy and paste the URL. 
	Limitations : 500KB max, .jpg or .png.
- Parcels will now be rewarded to players who earn enough Gems. These Parcels are from the biggest delivery services around the Edge.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/3e658735b8044459577aa98f98276a72f0ce6a52.png[/img]
	Parcels are items you can use to decorate your lobby, or open to obtain a reward at random. 
	By "enough Gems" is meant : more than the average of total gems available in a given adventure (not counting double bonus). 
	Emmm... let's just say try to be roughly thorough in picking Gems, and you should be fine. 
	Parcels are destroyed once opened. Please recycle. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/8b2ac7db56c2a19e4b01f1aae054400fbfc8275f.png[/img]
- New items have been introduced : Paint Bucket, and Fences.
- In lobby, when you are placing items, the item will be shown in either green or red if you are allowed to place it or not.
- A tower has appeared in the World Map. Something is coming...

Bug fixes :
- Rewards should now be dispatched correctly at the end of levels.
	As a reminder, rewards are available when you : 
		1. Clear a level for the first time solo, 
		2. Clear a level for the first time multiplayer, 
		3. Win a level for a first time, 
		4. Win a level, 
		5. End a level after having collected ALL gems, with DOUBLE POINTS BONUS from beginning to end
		6. And of course, a Parcel when you end a level with enough gems.
- Various minor fixes in levels.
- Various minor fixes in translation, the settings should now update the language correctly.
- Bugs fixed in home when piling up items

[b]IMPORTANT :
- All previous versions of Wawa United will not be able to synchronize with the server anymore. [/b]

notes.title: Monday Update & Upcoming stuff!
notes.content:
A Monday update has been published for both Demo and Full versions.

This small patch only contains a few minor graphical improvements, but also pre-loads the groundwork for new super exciting content coming very soon, including :

- [h1]Dungeons of Infinity[/h1] (new solo, randomly generated adventures)
Dungeons of Infinity are ever changing dungeons full of traps and mysteries. These very long and mysterious corridors are shaped by unstable magic, and will change every now and then. It is very unlikely a single Edger will be able to get to the end of these alone... however...

[b]Benefit from the experience of other adventurers[/b]

Throughout the levels, you will be able to leave signs on certain rocks. These are breadcrumb trails other adventurers will be able to see a,d read to avoid the mistakes you make, and hopefully progress further. 

In the end, everyone will benefit when a lucky fellow reaches the end!

- [h1]Leaderboards[/h1] 
Leaderboards are on the works, so you can access stats and compare yourself to other players. Leaderboards will be designed as an item to be placed on your lobby. This is a low priority feature but it has been under development for a while already.

- [h1]End level graffitis[/h1] 
When you reach the end of some levels for the first time, or when you win a game (in multiplayer), you will be given the opportunity to leave a custom message, in some cases also a custom emote.

- [h1]In-level graffitis[/h1] 
Even more useless! You will be able to leave a custom emote on some rocks disseminated throughout the levels. 

All these features should land this week or the next, with the exception of Dungeons which should take a little longer.

notes.title: Monday Update
notes.content:
A minor update has been applied to both demo and full versions. Here are the changes :

- Graphic improvements across the board, with more visual hints being displayed. Notably when all players are enjoying double gems.
- The world map has been improved. It still isn't exactly what it is meant to be, but it was one of the last feature added before initial release, therefore one of the least polished. 
- The zoom effects should now avoid letting the character go out of focus for no reason.
- Bug fixes.

Merry Christmas!

notes.title: Weekly Update
notes.content:
An update has been applied to both demo and full versions. Here are the changes :

  - Whenever you collect more than 40 Gems in a row (as displayed on the top right), you will now drop an extra power up that you can collect right away, or use later. This will compensate for the relative (and intended) lack of power-ups in the levels.
- Gems will now display a score pop up when they are collected.
- Some more improvements to UI. 
- End level UI will now display more information on bonus rewards.
- Graphic and gameplay Improvements to some levels.
- Names are now suggested if you don't feel inspired. 

Demo version:
- Demo players may now chose a name and will not be called "Random Wawa" then some number anymore.

Known issues:
- Blue Balls enemies may go into some funky dance when stomped. Always trust the flying ducks. 
- On lower end machines (if you are playing with 30FPS or less), some interactive elements are not always as responsive as they should be (chests, levers, torches), and may require you to press several times. This should be fixed soon.
- Matchmaking may refuse to turn off when trying to join a game solo from the map selection choice. As a side effect you may not be able to open solo levels. 
- The search bar for emotes does not work properly.

As always, I keep working in the background to implement the next levels and also future exciting features. 

Thank you all!

notes.title: Update: UI Overhaul
notes.content:
This update ships mainly with a hugely improved UI, which now looks much easier to read and is better looking than before. Notably, the matchmaking section has been simplified. 

Contents:
- Major UI overhaul. It now looks much better and is easier to understand.
- Graphics have been improved, mainly on characters and the lobby.
- Performances have been improved. 
- Gems affected by gravity should now stick better to moving platforms.
- Many improvements and bug fixes.
- In solo mode, your assistant frog will now be assigned a name instead of a number. 
- Translation has been improved.
- As always, background work is being done for future content. 

Known issues : 
- On lower end machines, activated items (chests, power tables, end level torches, etc.) are not always responsive.
- You won't be able to join a solo adventure if you have an active lobby, despite the prompt asking you to close the lobby. You will need to restart the game. This will be fixed shortly.

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
After a delay that turned longer than expected, this update introduces the solo mode, along with LOTS of improvements and bug fixes. 
Now the path should be cleared to move forward to other worlds and new levels. 

Update Notes:
- New Solo mode is now available : 
All multiplayer levels can be explored solo! Once you join an adventure, you will be able to invoke as many companions as you need, and take control of them one at a time. 
However, when you play solo, you'll need to reward your companion with half of everything you collected. 

Changes :
- The end level stats will now display more information.
- The world map has been improved and should be easier to navigate.

Bug fixes : 
- Fixed camera being jerky when hitting a wall or behaving incorrectly when on a moving platform.
- Fixed end level interface display bugs.
- Fixed graphic issues, resulting in a slight improvement in performance.
- All levels have been improved or modified.

notes.title: Delay On Solo Update
notes.content:
I initially wanted to publish the very exciting solo update last week, but it clearly needed more testing and wasn't ready by that time.

It shouldn't take much longer now, and will include lots of improvements and fixes as well.

Sorry for the delay.

notes.title: Monday update & announcement
notes.content:
November 10th 2020:

An update has been applied to both full and demo versions. Here are the changes:

	- New resolutions have been added, along with full screen option.
	- Some levels have had a slight graphic upgrade.
	- An effect has been applied to the Swords, so it is easier to evaluate their hit distance. 
	- UI has been changed so it's easier to see some buttons. 

Announcement to what's coming next:
	The next update will allow all levels to be played solo. You will be able to spawn and control players by switching between them. 
	Of course, multiplayer will remain the preferred game mode as the solo mode should earn significantly less rewards while allowing to progress through the game. 
	This mode still needs some testing but is expected to go live by next week.

notes.title: Monday Update
notes.content:
October 26th 2020:

An update has been applied to both full and demo versions. Here are the changes:

	- A few broken hints have been fixed, including the misleading "Press SHIFT to activate lever", which was a lie.
	- A few resolutions have been added.
	- Lots of background work on the next world. 
	- Global game size has increased so the size of update chunks would decrease.

Known issues :
- After unlocking a new level, you need to reload your lobby (ESC + "Back To Home") to be able to access it.

notes.title: Demo: hotfixed
notes.content:
The demo version has been hot fixed as promised. The level "The Underedge Pass" should now be available to unlock & play as it always should have been the case.

Note that both full and demo version players can play this level seamlessly with each other. Demo players can also purchase items from The Smuggler's Den, which is directly available after the Underedge. Of course, The Underedge Pass isn't exactly the best source of Gems income. 

Anyway, sorry for the inconvenience and the confusion.

notes.title: Monday Update & Important Demo notice
notes.content:
October 18th 2020:

[b]IMPORTANT[/b], concerning the demo :
It has been brought to my attention that unlocking the level "The Underedge Pass", the first multiplayer level past the tutorial, was impossible with the demo version. 
This is not intentional, the level should be available along with the items shop "Smuggler's Den".
This will be fixed shortly and I am very sorry for the inconvenience, and the misconception that I would ship a demo only containing a tutorial level. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/c8c14e9b773c7c21d6d26addea2af69ef9da8fa2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38227995/16f1704f4b95798ed017e291b7e85e674bcbda40.png[/img][/url]
Expect a hotfix shortly.



An update has been applied to both full and demo versions. Here are the changes:

	- Hints are now displayed correctly acording to options.
	- An option to find other players directly from the world map has been added. Condidering the modest player base, it is still advised to play with friends.
	- More hints have been added, including in the world map, to better indicate what is going on and the options available.
	- Bug fixes across the board.
	- A button to access the menu has been added to the main screen.
	- Unused content has been removed to better optimize the game size

Known issues :
- After unlocking a new level, you need to reload your lobby (ESC + "Back To Home") to be able to access it.

notes.title: Minor Update Released
notes.content:
A little late on the schedule as always but this time because of the National Holidays in China.

A small update has been applied to both full and demo versions. Here are the changes:

	- Hints have appeared to indicate which enemies can be stunned (by jumping on them). 
	- Another hint is available to indicate which characters can be transported (including players).
	- Hints can be enabled or disabled in the settings menu, they are enabled by default.
	- A button to access the menu has been added to the main screen.

notes.title: The Monday Update
notes.content:
September 30th 2020:

The Monday update had been pushed with some delay due to additional testing. Here are the changes:

[i]The original plan was to drop the players into the game as fast as possible with as little fuss as possible. It appears that some semblance of guidance is still necessary. That is why the main focus lately has been to make the beginning of the game and its learning curve easier to understand.[/i]

	- The Hidden Bay of Wonders has been simplified to better focus on the learning curve of the game.
	- Hints have been added to the world map in an attempt to make it easier to read.
	- Some levels have been slightly modified and bug fixed.

notes.title: Minor Unscheduled Update
notes.content:
A small update has been applied to both full and demo versions. Here are the changes:

	- Tips have been added on loading screens.
	- Reminders have been added when a new unlockable map is available.
	- Reminders have been added when gems-generating items have gems available.
	- Gems appearance have been slightly modified for performance.
	- The background sound has been lowered in the Home level. You will now hear birds from time to time :) 
	- Background work on the next contents to come.

notes.title: Minor Unscheduled Update
notes.content:
A small update has been applied to both full and demo versions. The main point of this update is to make the learning stages and especially the default key binds easier to understand. 

Here are the changes:

	- Some descriptions/texts have been improved, including in the tutorial level "The Hidden Bay of Wonders", The key binds should now be written clearly and consistently. Some legacy descriptions that did not make sense or were outdated have been changed.
	- "The Hidden Bay of Wonders" has been slightly simplified.
	- Fixed a bug that would cause the purchasable items in "The Smuggler's Den" to be displayed wrongly.

Reminder : the game options, including key bind customization, are found in the Main Menu - Settings panel which is accessible by pressing ESC.

notes.title: Monday Update
notes.content:
20200921 update released for both demo and full versions. 

This update includes :
- Minor bug fixes and tweaks. 
- Naming characters will now be only available to full version owners. Demo owners who previously named their characters can indeed keep their names. The "Ink and quill" item will not be useable by demo owners but can still be placed in the lobby.
